first_screen_adapter:
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Adapter for script/screen from the native-yjit-bench exploration branch.
# No application/config edits; entropy controls apply only to untimed checks.
require_relative "lobsters_url_program"
require_relative "../../fixtures/corpus/blog_entropy"

module NativeBench::Exploration
  class << self
    def install(config:, state:, arm:)
      policy = JSON.parse(File.read(config.fetch("url_entropy_policy")))
      validation = BlogProduction::Entropy.validate(config.fetch("app"), policy: policy)
      raise validation.fetch("reason") unless validation.fetch("active")
      BlogProduction::Entropy.install(policy)
      workload = NativeBench.routes(config, state, arm)
      LobstersUrlProgram.discover do
        workload.each_value { raise "discovery HTTP failure" unless _1.call.status == 200 }
      end
      LobstersUrlProgram.compile(coverage: !ENV["LOWRAIL_STATS"].nil?)
      raise "no naturally observed fixed URL programs" if LobstersUrlProgram.programs.empty?
      LobstersUrlProgram.select(arm == "on")
    end

    def validation_request(route:, seed:, request:)
      response, evidence = BlogProduction::Entropy.with(seed, route, wall_clock: true) { request.call }
      [response, evidence.merge("passed" => evidence.fetch("errors").empty?,
        "control" => "existing declared-site entropy companion; actual body and all headers compared")]
    end

    def counts = LobstersUrlProgram.counts
  end
end

first_screen_policy.scope: Disposable Lobsters URL-program untimed validation only; never timed entropy or production security certification

controls.secret_key_base: Unchanged ruby-bench Lobsters benchmark configuration; no override
controls.random: Per-workflow, per-declared-site Random seeded with SHA256(seed/scenario ID/site); streams continue over session round trips; integer bytes, not OpenSSL RNG reseeding
controls.runtime: Only Rack::Runtime#call's two Rack::Utils.clock_time reads per request return successive 0.001-second inputs; real reads retained separately; x-runtime remains a literal compared header, not a performance measurement
controls.session: Anonymous Rack::MockRequest GETs with no retained cookies, in every arm; no security certification
controls.state: Copied shipped primary.sqlite3 snapshot and cleared tmp before each serial worker; no transaction rollback
controls.wall_clock: Untimed validation only: Time.now reads on the active request thread return the declared epoch; real reads and call sites retained; timed requests retain real clocks
